items.title: File Widerspruch against refusal of hunting licence
items.quote: Binnen eines Monats ab der Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids ist der Widerspruch zulässig; er wird schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift bei folgender Stelle erhoben: Kreis Musterdithmarschen, Stiftstraße 8, 25746 Musterheide in Holstein.
items.computation: Letter dated 19.11.2026 (Thursday), sent by ordinary mail. Per the clause quoted in the letter (§110 Abs.2 LVwG), a notice sent by simple letter is deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting. Counting from the day after posting (20.11.=day1, 21.11.=day2, 22.11.=day3, 23.11.=day4): deemed Bekanntgabe = Monday 23.11.2026. The one-month Widerspruchsfrist runs from this event; per §188 Abs.2 BGB the period ends with the day in the following month bearing the same number as the day of the event, i.e. 23.12.2026 (Wednesday). 23.12.2026 is a regular working day in Schleswig-Holstein (not a weekend or public holiday), so no further shift under §193 BGB is needed.

items.title: Submit valid hunting liability insurance confirmation to receive the hunting licence
items.quote: Sobald Sie eine gültige Versicherungsbestätigung nachreichen, stelle ich den Jagdschein ohne neuen Antrag aus.
items.computation: The letter states the licence will be issued once a valid insurance confirmation is submitted, but gives no calendar date or period for doing so, so no fixed due date can be computed; this is an open-ended precondition rather than a dated deadline.

warnings: The letter itself states the delivery-fiction rule (§110 Abs. 2 LVwG, deemed delivered on the 4th day after posting), which was used to compute the deemed Bekanntgabe date and hence the Widerspruch deadline; verify the actual posting date if it differs from the printed Bescheiddatum, as that would shift the deadline.
